basic_info.description: Perched above the street with sweeping views of Sutro Tower and Twin Peaks, this sunlit top-floor 2BD/1BA condo offers approx. 1,309 sq. ft. (per graphic artist) of classic San Francisco charm. Natural light pours into every corner, highlighting the home's high ceilings, period details, and hardwood floors. Situated on a designated Slow Street in the heart of Hayes Valley, you're surrounded by beloved parks, cafs, and boutiques. Additional features include a full in-unit laundry room, shared outdoor patio, 1-car tandem parking, and extra storage in the garage. Boasting a 98 Walk Score, 92 Transit Score, and 87 Bike Score, it's ideally located near Duboce Park, Alamo Square, and Koshland Park, with easy access to public transit, freeways, and local favorites like Ritual Coffee, The Mill, NOPA, and Souvla. A rare opportunity to own a spacious residence in one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods.
